title: Member Equities & Patronage Servicing Standard — Cancelling Class H Preferred Stock Shares above the Holding Ceiling, with Platform Reference
content:
When a purchase has been accepted that takes a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding above the holding ceiling, the shares above it are cancelled and refunded.

## Rule

1. When a purchase has been accepted that takes a Class H Preferred Stock holding above the holding ceiling, the shares above it are cancelled as of the date of that purchase (the holding's latest purchase) and refunded within the class's subscription refund period in calendar days by the payout method on the holding, as one entry with reason subscription cancelled.
2. A holding whose counted shares do not exceed the holding ceiling has nothing cancelled under this rule.

## Business effect

One cancellation entry is recorded on the holding for the par amount of the shares above the ceiling, with the reason subscription cancelled, dated as of the purchase that took the holding over; the money goes back by the payout method on the holding — direct deposit to the account on file, otherwise check — and the holding's balance falls by the same amount. The member can then see the cancellation entry and the lower balance.

## Platform reference: `refund_preferred_holding_excess_154bc05b`

**Capability.** Cancels and refunds the Class H Preferred Stock shares a holding carries above the largest balance a member may hold: one cancellation entry for the par amount given, dated as of the date given, with the reason subscription cancelled, lowering the holding's balance by the same amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the servicing representative unlocks `refund_preferred_holding_excess_154bc05b` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `equity_id` | The reference number of the member's Class H Preferred Stock holding, read from the member's equity holdings lookup | Identifier, text |
| `amount` | The par amount of shares cancelled and refunded | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |
| `effective_date` | The date the cancellation takes effect as of | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time part |

**Return.** On success a receipt with `status` "refunded"; `eq_txn_id`, the reference of the cancellation entry (text); `equity_id`, the holding (text); `amount`, the USD refunded (2 decimal places); `payment_method`, how the refund was sent — `direct_deposit` or `check`; `effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD); and `new_balance`, the holding's balance afterwards (USD, 2 decimal places).

## Contract questions

**As of which date is the cancellation dated?** The date passed in `effective_date`; under the rule above it is the date of the purchase that took the holding over the ceiling.

**How is the refund sent?** By the payout method on the holding: direct deposit when the holding is set to direct deposit, otherwise check.
